mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% indicates a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE <5.0%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0%, contradicting the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) proxies signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising, or their combined effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in the federal funds rate below 0.10% amplifies market optimism, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when FEDFUNDS drops below 0.10% in the tightening regime, or the effect is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) above 107.0 indicates expanding supply capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in >60% of INDPRO upward periods, or the effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 5.0% triggers a labor market strengthening signal, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when UNRATE crosses below 5.0%, or the effect is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP (GDPC1) coupled with increasing housing demand (HOUST) creates a synergistic demand boost, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising, or their combined effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% signals deflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when CPIAUCSL drops below 2.0% in the late-cycle regime, or the effect is not significant (p>0.05).
